title: Calling in the Netherlands, screens: the agency's number requirements form and pending states, recording default and Dutch announcement, super admin bundle review, NL phone formats in the desktop
goal: An NL agency can follow the whole number set-up on screen: what the provider needs, upload it, see it pass the platform's review and the provider's review, then buy a number. The super admin reviews and submits bundles and sees draft prices flagged.
why: R137 adds the regulatory bundle flow and NL policy in the backend; without screens the agency sees only an error. Design: TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 5.6 and 16.

edit: desktop/src/components/ui/phone-input.tsx (only if the NL tests show a defect)
super-admin/src/lib/api.ts (or the file the calling panel calls through)

steps: Requirements form rendered from GET /voip/numbers/requirements (fields of kyc_requirements: text, address with AddressAutocomplete and a manual fallback, date, file via the existing FileUpload); countries without a list keep the current upload.

Status chips for each state of design 5.6 (Not started, Submitted, Platform review, Provider review, Approved, Rejected with the reason and a Resubmit action); a clear pending message: 'Under review by the phone provider. We will email you when it is approved.' (no duration is claimed).
The Buy number button is disabled with the reason until approved; the price shows, or 'Price not set yet for your country' for PRICE_NOT_CONFIGURED.
Every string through t('calling.*'), en and nl.

Recording: shows the country default ('In your country recordings are announced by default') and the current mode; the announcement preview in the agency language with the default Dutch text for an nl agency; a short privacy note ('Recording calls needs a lawful basis and a notice to callers under the GDPR. Check with your adviser.').
Tenant calling panel: for a bundle country, the submitted fields and files, Approve and submit to provider, Refresh status, Reset; the provider status and failure reason.

Catalogue page: rows whose provider text starts with 'DRAFT' are flagged 'Draft price' and cannot be activated without editing the unit cost (client-side guard; the backend accepts the edit as today).

items.what: NL phone formats in the desktop
steps: phone-input.nl.test.tsx: with agency country NL, '0612345678', '06 1234 5678' and '+31 6 1234 5678' all give +31612345678; '0852080400' gives +31852080400; display uses the national format. Fix PhoneInput only if a case fails.

tests: desktop vitest: requirements form renders each field type and validates required ones; bundle-status shows the right chip and action per state; phone-input NL cases.

e2e/calling-nl.spec.ts (multi mode, VOIP_PROVIDER=mock, an NL agency on a plan with voip_calling): the agency fills the requirements and uploads a file; the super admin API approves; the mock provider approves; the agency sees Approved and buys a number when the NL price is activated off camera through the super admin API; with the price inactive the button shows 'Price not set yet'.
super-admin: tsc, lint and build pass.
acceptance: Every bundle state is visible to the agency with a next step; nothing fails silently.
The super admin can review, submit and track a bundle.
gate: cd desktop && npx tsc --noEmit && npx tsc -p electron/tsconfig.json --noEmit
cd desktop && npx vitest run   # 0 failing files; passed >= the count at the last merge
cd super-admin && npx tsc --noEmit && npm run lint && npm run build
cd desktop && E2E_BASE_URL=http://localhost:3120 E2E_API_URL=http://localhost:8807/api/v1 npx playwright test e2e/calling-nl.spec.ts e2e/voip-settings.spec.ts e2e/super-admin.spec.ts
productRules: Generic product: no prospect or customer names anywhere.
Feature switch: voip_calling plus the country gate (useCallingOffered); calling UI stays hidden where calling is not offered.
Desktop: CONTRACT.md; PhoneInput for phones; FileUpload for documents; t() with en and nl keys only in messages/<lang>/calling.json; RTL-safe classes.
Env-dependent features degrade gracefully (no provider configured: the form still saves and shows 'waiting for review').
Never weaken, skip or delete an existing test.
notes: Before editing read: this file, TOUR-OPERATOR-DESIGN.md sections 5.6 and 16, R137's routes (voip.ts, admin-voip.ts), desktop/audit/remake/CONTRACT.md, super-admin calling panel.
The fix-stack start for the e2e needs VOIP_PROVIDER=mock and NL in the calling countries (FIX_STACK_CALLING_COUNTRIES=GB,US,AU,SG,NL).
goLiveVerify: The provider's review e-mail or callback reaches the agency in production.
